name: Vite
description: Vite is modeled as build/development tooling, not as the authority for application-layer folder architecture.

rules.title: Treat Vite as build tooling
rules.summary: Vite provides a development server and production build pipeline; Agentic Harness must not infer services/stores/views or other application architecture merely from Vite usage.

sources.title: Getting Started | Vite
sources.notes: Official documentation defines Vite around its development server, build command, plugins and configuration.
